findings.title: Закрепить receipt независимого oracle до проверки его списка хешей
findings.trigger: Local receipt has files=[] or a replacement oracle plus self-updated file hash/source metadata.
findings.actual: main returns PASS and hardcodes MR11 commit even when oracle bytes are not the independently delivered exact MR11 file.
findings.impact: The admission does not enforce its declared independent immutable oracle provenance. Four data pins remain effective; no frozen numeric error or new economics is demonstrated.
findings.minimal_fix: Pin SHA256 of the independently verified exact receipt (8373a8085682cc9df3660433f8024a78a377f9b512c93d05ecaafbc9a71d2db6) before JSON parsing; retain existing oracle file hash checks. Alternatively anchor oracle directly to MR11 git object and validate fixed receipt coverage/provenance.

nonblocking_scope_observations.observation: A capacity endpoint metadata mutation passes validate API; main rejects changes to pinned capacity bytes. No universal-validator requirement inferred.
Day1 affected set equality is insufficient alone. Selected dated legs and later-day witness were checked independently using absolute minutes exactly once; old interaction code unchanged.
